module_summary: UDP checksum generator: a 5-state FSM latches header fields, accumulates a ones-complement checksum over pseudo-header and 64-bit payload while the payload streams into an AXIS FIFO, then pushes header, length and checksum into a header FIFO for output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Controller: idle, sum header, sum payload, two finish steps; drives header store and payload shifting.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input header valid; with ready starts checksum frame.

anchors.name: s_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Input header ready, registered in IDLE when header FIFO not full.

anchors.name: store_udp_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all input header fields into holding registers.

anchors.name: ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched header field held until written into header FIFO.

anchors.name: ip_dest_ip_reg
anchors.why: Latched destination IP summed into pseudo-header checksum.

anchors.name: udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: Latched UDP port summed into checksum in SUM_HEADER state.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload beats summed into checksum and written to payload FIFO.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid, gated by shift_payload_in into FIFO.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready: FIFO ready gated by shift_payload_in.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte keep selects bytes summed and word_cnt length increment.

anchors.name: s_udp_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of payload; moves FSM to checksum finish.

anchors.name: shift_payload_in
anchors.why: Passes payload into FIFO only in SUM_PAYLOAD state.

anchors.name: checksum_reg
anchors.why: Ones-complement checksum accumulator, folded and inverted in finish state.

anchors.name: checksum_temp1_reg
anchors.why: Partial sum of low payload bytes, pipelined into checksum_reg.

anchors.name: checksum_temp2_reg
anchors.why: Partial sum of high payload bytes, pipelined into checksum_reg.

anchors.name: checksum_part
anchors.why: End-around carry fold of checksum_reg halves.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: UDP length byte counter accumulating word_cnt; stored as udp_length.

anchors.name: word_cnt
anchors.why: Valid byte count of beat from tkeep; increments length and checksum.

anchors.name: hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pulsed after checksum finish; triggers header FIFO write.

anchors.name: header_fifo_write
anchors.why: Writes all header fields, length, checksum into header FIFO.

anchors.name: header_fifo_read
anchors.why: Reads header FIFO entry into output header registers.

anchors.name: header_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO write pointer addressing all header memories.

anchors.name: header_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header FIFO read pointer addressing all header memories.

anchors.name: header_fifo_full
anchors.why: Header FIFO full blocks writes and input header ready.

anchors.name: header_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Header FIFO empty blocks reads and drops output valid.

anchors.name: udp_checksum_mem
anchors.why: Header FIFO memory holding computed checksums; representative of header field memories.

anchors.name: udp_length_mem
anchors.why: Header FIFO memory holding computed UDP lengths.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid from header FIFO read side.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Output header ready advances header FIFO read.

anchors.name: m_udp_checksum
anchors.why: Computed UDP checksum output.

anchors.name: m_udp_length
anchors.why: Computed UDP length output, also derives m_ip_length.

anchors.name: m_ip_length
anchors.why: IP length computed as UDP length plus 20.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload stream from payload FIFO.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from payload FIFO.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level when FSM not idle.

groups.name: Checksum FSM
groups.description: Sequences header capture, header and payload summing, checksum finish and FIFO push.

groups.name: Header holding registers
groups.description: Input header fields latched by store_udp_hdr for summing and FIFO write.

groups.name: Checksum datapath
groups.description: Pipelined ones-complement adder and length counter over pseudo-header and payload.

groups.name: Payload FIFO
groups.description: AXIS FIFO buffering payload while its header checksum is computed.

groups.name: Header FIFO
groups.description: Field-wise memories queueing completed headers with length and checksum.

groups.name: Output header
groups.description: Registered output header fields read from header FIFO.
